parsed.why: State executive order fixes sex at birth and backs single-sex facilities; youth care ban; no statewide gender-identity protections; documented prison harm. Adds hostile local layer to restrictive national regime.
No statewide adult bathroom ban or adult care ban, but appointed boards target youth care/sports, district bathroom policy, no gender-identity hate-crime or statewide nondiscrimination coverage.

Sanctuary care law and identity-based prison housing plus surgery funding are real local positives; high raw anti-LGBTQ incident count lacks denominator, and national border/document regime still caps safety.

Strongest local protections: shield laws, comprehensive insurance coverage, court-ordered prison care. But national passport/facility layer remains, and pending ballot initiatives could erode protections.
Worst-law tier: March 2025 sex statute reaches bathrooms, locker rooms, dormitories and prisons; no statewide gender-identity protections; religious-refusal shield; local ordinances threatened.
